subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for the external fork PR to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a narrow in-repository fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug and implementation boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fix
options.body: Open a narrow in-repository replacement or maintainer-owned adoption, credit the external attempt, and close the external path after a viable replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the external fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait without replacement
options.body: Leave the issue and external PR open, accepting that the known source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Open a narrow in-repository replacement or maintainer-owned adoption, credit the external attempt, and close the external path after a viable replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the original shared sanitizer merge and the TUI leading-strip path, making them the strongest routing owner for this choice.
